lines.en: label day79:
scene street_noon
Ahh, Friday...the best true weekday of the-
lines.zh: 啊，星期五……一周里最棒的真·工作日——

lines.en: Well...week.
lines.zh: 好吧……一周。

lines.en: With over 48 hours on the clock starting right now to do whatever I want, I begin to wonder exactly what the best use of my time would be.
lines.zh: 从现在起有超过四十八个小时可以随心所欲，我开始琢磨到底该怎么用掉这些时间才最划算。

lines.en: But as I make my way down the street, slightly exhausted from another eventful day as a professional educator, I spot several familiar faces...
lines.zh: 但当我沿街走着，被又一天「职业教育工作者」的多事之秋折腾得有些疲惫时，我看见了几个熟悉的身影……

lines.en: scene beachday1
: Oh, hey! What are you doing over here?
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨！你在这儿干什么呢？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}I'm{/i} on my way back from school...which is what I assumed two out of three of you would also be up to. So why are you already dressed in your casual clothes?
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我{/i}正从学校往回走……我还以为你们三个里至少有两个也是这么回事呢。那你们怎么已经换上便装了？

lines.en: : The last bell only rang like...half an hour ago.
lines.zh: : 最后一节课的铃声也就……半小时前才响过吧。

lines.en: scene beachday2
: Chinami doesn’t go to[school] so she can do whatever she wants!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不去[school]，所以 Chinami 想干什么就干什么！

lines.en: : Good for you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 真有你的，Chinami。

lines.en: I gaze at Chika, slightly confused by both the clothing situation as well as why she’s allowing her sister out in public given her whole immunodeficiency thing.
lines.zh: 我望向 Chika，有点纳闷——既纳闷她们这身衣服是怎么回事，也纳闷考虑到她妹妹那免疫缺陷的毛病，她怎么还敢把人带到公共场合来。

lines.en: : Don't look at me like that, Sensei. I know what you're thinking.
lines.zh: : 别用那种眼神看我，Sensei。我知道你在想什么。

lines.en: scene beachday3
: The reason I'm not still in my uniform is...I actually left a couple hours early so I'd have time to meet up with Yumi and Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我没穿校服是因为……其实我提前几个小时就走了，这样才有时间和 Yumi 跟 Chinami 汇合。

lines.en: : You were asleep when I left so you probably just...didn't notice.
lines.zh: : 我走的时候你还睡着呢，所以你大概只是……没注意到。

lines.en: : Do you guys have plans to go somewhere?
lines.zh: : 你们几个是打算去哪儿吗？

lines.en: : That’s right. We have plans. So how about you do us a favor and-
lines.zh: : 没错。我们有安排。所以你就行行好，然后——

lines.en: scene beachday4
: Hey! No being mean! Chinami doesn't want to be friends with mean people!
lines.zh: : 喂！不许凶！Chinami 不想跟凶巴巴的人做朋友！

lines.en: : What? I'm not being mean. I just-
lines.zh: : 什么？我哪有凶。我只是——

lines.en: : Leave big sis Chika’s boyfriend alone or he won’t come say hi to Chinami anymore!
lines.zh: : 别欺负 Chika 姐姐的男朋友，不然他就不来找 Chinami 打招呼了！

lines.en: scene beachday5
: Chinami...I told you he isn’t my boyfriend. He’s mine and Yumi’s teacher.
lines.zh: : Chinami……我都说了他不是我男朋友。他是我和 Yumi 的老师。

lines.en: : Yumi goes to[school]? Chinami had no idea.
lines.zh: : Yumi 也去[school]吗？Chinami 完全不知道。

lines.en: : Chinami, for the last time, please start saying “I” instead of “Chinami.”
lines.zh: : Chinami，我最后说一次，请开始用「我」来称呼自己，别再说「Chinami」了。

lines.en: : But “I” isn’t Chinami’s name. “Chinami” is.
lines.zh: : 可是「我」不是 Chinami 的名字呀。「Chinami」才是。

lines.en: : Of course I go to friggin' school, Chinami...Just...not as much as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我当然他妈的上学啊，Chinami……只是……没其他人上得那么勤罢了。

lines.en: scene beachday7
: You’re, uhh...probably having a hard time following this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你，呃……大概听得一头雾水吧？

lines.en: : It's less that I'm having a hard time following and more that you three are just an...interesting group.
lines.zh: : 与其说我听得费劲，不如说你们三个凑在一起实在是个……有意思的组合。

lines.en: : It seems like even Yumi is trying her best to behave around Chinami. I haven’t heard her curse at me once so far.
lines.zh: : 看起来连 Yumi 在 Chinami 面前都在努力安分守己。到现在为止她一句脏话都没冲我飙过。

lines.en: scene beachday8
: You’re lucky there’s a kid around. Even I ain't messed up enough to be a negative influence on someone like her.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，这儿有个小孩在。就算我再混蛋，也不至于去带坏她这样的人。

lines.en: : Yumi is Chinami’s second big sister! She visits all the time and brings me candy and other fun things!
lines.zh: : Yumi 是 Chinami 的第二个姐姐！她老是来看我，还给我带糖果和别的好玩的东西！

lines.en: : Is that so?...
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？……

lines.en: : What? Why do you look so surprised?!
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你那副惊讶的表情是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : To get back on track, the three of us made plans to go to the beach today.
lines.zh: : 言归正传，我们三个约好了今天要去海边。

lines.en: : The beach? Isn’t it a little late for that? The sun's going to be setting any minute.
lines.zh: : 海边？这会儿去是不是有点晚了？太阳随时就要落山了。

lines.en: : That’s exactly why we need to go {i}now.{/i} If we went any earlier, there would be too many people and it wouldn’t be safe for Chinami.
lines.zh: : 正因为如此才得{i}现在{/i}去。要是再早一点，人太多了，对 Chinami 就不安全了。

lines.en: : The beach will be dead in, like...thirty minutes. So this is really the only time we can go.
lines.zh: : 大概再过……三十分钟海边就没人了。所以我们真的只有这个时间能去。

lines.en: : That’s right. So you should probably start heading back home to your-
lines.zh: : 没错。所以你差不多该动身回你的——

lines.en: scene beachday10
: Come with us!
lines.zh: : 跟我们一起去嘛！

lines.en: : Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami？

lines.en: : Wait, hold on a second. He can’t come, he’s a-
lines.zh: : 等等，等一下。他不能来，他是个——

lines.en: : Chinami wants to show him her new bathing suit!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想给他看 Chinami 的新泳衣！

lines.en: : Chinami...I’m sure Sensei is super busy and-
lines.zh: : Chinami……Sensei 肯定特别忙，而且——

lines.en: : I’ll come.
lines.zh: : 我去。

lines.en: scene beachday11
: Huh? Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 咦？等等，真的吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I didn’t have much planned for the rest of the day anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然。反正我今天剩下的时间也没什么安排。

lines.en: Plus, who would I be to deny the sight of two and a half adorable girls wearing swimsuits? This opportunity doesn't present itself every day.
lines.zh: 再说了，我凭什么要拒绝两个半可爱女孩穿泳衣的画面？这种机会可不是天天都有的。

lines.en: I didn’t even realize Kumon-mi had a beach until a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: 直到几分钟前我才知道 Kumon-mi 居然还有海滩。

lines.en: So not only am I going to be gifted with a rare and wonderful sight, I’m {i}also{/i} going to find out more about the surrounding area.
lines.zh: 所以我不仅能饱览难得一见的美景，{i}还{/i}能顺便摸清周边的环境。

lines.en: This is basically a scientific research trip. And as the teacher for the majority of these girls, I’d be foolish not to go.
lines.zh: 这基本上就是一次科学考察。而且作为这几个女孩里大多数人的老师，我要是不去那才叫傻。

lines.en: : Oh hell no! Not a chance! No way am I going to wear a bathing suit in front of this creep!
lines.zh: : 哦，去他妈的！门都没有！我才不要在这个变态面前穿泳衣！

lines.en: : Chinami will!
lines.zh: : Chinami 要穿！

lines.en: : Are you really sure, Sensei? I don't want you feeling like a chaperone or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你真的确定吗，Sensei？我不想让你觉得自己像个监护人什么的。

lines.en: : It's fine if it's for scientific research, right?
lines.zh: : 如果是为了科学研究那就没问题，对吧？

lines.en: : Scientific research my ass! You just want to perv out on us!
lines.zh: : 科学研究个屁！你就是想对着我们发情！

lines.en: scene beachday12
: So what? You look hot as hell in your bathing suit, Yumi. What do you have to lose?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你穿泳衣的样子性感得要命，Yumi。你有什么好亏的？

lines.en: : Are you seriously okay with this guy having his eyes all over you?!
lines.zh: : 你是认真的吗，让这家伙的眼睛在你身上乱瞟？！

lines.en: : Yeah, kind of.
lines.zh: : 嗯，差不多吧。

lines.en: : What?! The hell is going on with you lately?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你最近到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: scene beachday13
: Sensei...if you're {i}really{/i} sure you have the time, two of us would love to have you.
lines.zh: : Sensei……如果你{i}真的{/i}确定有空的话，我们中有两个人会很乐意你一起来。

lines.en: : Yeah. And the third one is currently thinking about whether or not she should swim out into the ocean to never be seen again...
lines.zh: : 是啊。而第三个人现在正在考虑要不要游进大海深处，从此消失不见……

lines.en: scene black
The bus shows up several minutes later and, like Chika predicted, there’s barely anyone on it.
lines.zh: 几分钟后巴士来了，正如 Chika 所料，车上几乎没什么人。

lines.en: As it turns out, the beach is only about fifteen minutes away.
lines.zh: 结果发现，海滩离这儿也就十五分钟车程。

lines.en: I have no idea how I didn’t know this until now, but that’s definitely interesting.
lines.zh: 我真不知道自己怎么到现在才知道这地方，不过这确实挺有意思的。

lines.en: It seems that Kumon-mi has pretty much everything that anyone could ever want in it...
lines.zh: 看来 Kumon-mi 几乎包罗了任何人想要的一切……

lines.en: scene beachday14
: So, Sensei...Are you excited to see Yumi and me in our swimsuits? Is your heart pounding?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei……要看到我和 Yumi 穿泳衣的样子，你兴奋吗？心跳加速了吗？

lines.en: : You seem pretty eager to show yourself off, Chika. If I didn't know any better, I might think you're trying to seduce me right now.
lines.zh: : 你似乎相当急于展示自己啊，Chika。要不是我了解你，我可能会以为你现在正试图勾引我呢。

lines.en: : Seduce you? Me? Of course not. I just want to spend some quality time with my teacher, my best friend, and my sister. What's seductive about that?
lines.zh: : 勾引你？我？当然不是。我只是想和我的老师、我最好的朋友还有我妹妹共度美好时光而已。这有什么好勾引的？

lines.en: : Nothing when you put it that way, no. But that smug grin and concern for my heart rate is telling another story.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，确实没什么。不过你那副得意的笑容，还有对我心跳的关心，讲的可是另一个故事。

lines.en: scene beachday15
: Uh...the two of us are gonna go get changed, so make sure Stalky McGee over there doesn’t follow us in.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们俩要去换衣服了，所以你给我看紧点，别让那边那个跟踪狂麦克基跟进来。

lines.en: : What kind of immature nickname is that?
lines.zh: : 这外号也太幼稚了吧？

lines.en: : Does this mean big-sis will be Chika McGee once they get married?
lines.zh: : 那是不是说等她们结婚以后，姐姐就会变成 Chika 麦克基了？

lines.en: : Please hurry up. I don't want to deal with this on my own.
lines.zh: : 拜托你快点。我可不想一个人应付这些。

lines.en: : Sounds good, Yumi. I'll be right in.
lines.zh: : 好的，Yumi。我马上就进去。

lines.en: scene beachday16
: Sucks you didn’t have time to go home and grab your bathing suit. Was looking forward to seeing my teacher shirtless.
lines.zh: : 真可惜你没时间回家拿泳衣。我还挺期待看我的老师光膀子的样子呢。

lines.en: : I’m sure there will be plenty more opportunities to see me shirtless. I wouldn’t worry too much.
lines.zh: : 以后看我光膀子的机会多着呢。你不必太担心。

lines.en: : Heheh...oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……哦是吗？

lines.en: : Lucky for you, you’ll get your first opportunity to see {i}me{/i} like that in just a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，再过几分钟你就能第一次看到{i}我{/i}这副模样了。

lines.en: : Hope I don't...{i}disappoint...{/i}
lines.zh: : 希望我不会让你……{i}失望……{/i}

lines.en: scene beachday18
And just like that, Chika disappears into the women’s restroom.
lines.zh: 就这样，Chika 消失在了女洗手间里。

lines.en: I can hear Chinami’s giggling bouncing off of the tiled walls and finding its way back onto the beach...as if gently reminding me that the act of following them here is much more perverse than it seems.
lines.zh: 我能听见 Chinami 的笑声在贴着瓷砖的墙壁上反弹，一路飘回海滩……仿佛在轻声提醒我，跟着她们来这里这件事，比看上去要变态得多。

lines.en: scene beachday19
I move closer to the water and look out toward the horizon.
lines.zh: 我走近海水，望向地平线。

lines.en: Sure, it's getting a little late in the day, but it’s still surprising seeing a beach empty- especially since there are still mats and chairs laid out.
lines.zh: 虽说天色确实有点晚了，但看到空无一人的海滩还是让人有些意外——尤其这里还摆着成排的沙滩垫和躺椅。

lines.en: I'm not sure what kind of person just...leaves all of their stuff lying around a place like this, but I guess it doesn't make any sort of difference to me.
lines.zh: 我搞不懂什么样的人会……把自己的东西全扔在这种地方不管，不过反正对我也没什么影响。

lines.en: I’m just here to hang out with cute girls and get some ‘research’ done.
lines.zh: 我来这儿只是为了陪可爱的女孩子玩玩，顺便做点「研究」而已。

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and listen to the sounds of the girls' voices blend in with the wind and the water, hoping that they don't wind up taking too long in there...
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，听着女孩们的声音与风声、水声交织在一起，只希望她们别在里面磨蹭太久……

lines.en: scene beachday20
: Hey~
: Did you miss me?
lines.zh: : 想我了吗？

lines.en: Jesus Christ.
lines.zh: 天哪。

lines.en: : Wow.
: You like?
lines.zh: : 喜欢吗？

lines.en: scene beachday21
: We just started selling these at the mall and I kinda {i}needed{/i} to buy one since my old swimsuit is way too small for me now. I look hot, right?
lines.zh: : 商场里刚上架这款，我有点{i}想买{/i}，因为我那件旧泳衣现在对我来说明显太小了。我看起来很性感吧？

lines.en: : I’m kind of at a loss for words, to be honest. Well, at least words that wouldn't land me on some sort of list.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我有点不知道该说什么好。至少是那种不会让我被拉进什么名单的话。

lines.en: : I won't tell if you don't~
lines.zh: : 你不说，我就不说~

lines.en: : I'm gonna go lay out and try to tan for a bit before {i}all{/i} of the sun is gone, but feel free to come by and spend some more time with me if you like.
lines.zh: : 趁着太阳还没{i}完全{/i}落下去，我要去摊开晒一会儿、美黑一下，不过你要是想过来多陪陪我，随时欢迎。

lines.en: scene beachday19
Chika suddenly walks off and begins to lay out a towel and, in case you were wondering, she looks equally as attractive from behind.
lines.zh: Chika 突然走开，开始铺她的浴巾——顺便说一句，如果你好奇的话，她从后面看同样迷人。

lines.en: Another minute or so passes by before I hear the second set of footsteps closing in on me from behind.
lines.zh: 又过了一分钟左右，我听见第二串脚步声从身后逼近。

lines.en: They’re a bit more aggressive than the first ones- almost like someone is angrily kicking their way through the sand.
lines.zh: 这串脚步声比刚才那串要暴躁一些——简直像是有人正怒气冲冲地踢着沙子走过来。

lines.en: That in mind, I’m assuming these footsteps belong to...
lines.zh: 这么一想，我猜这串脚步声属于……

lines.en: scene beachday23
: Where did Chika go?
lines.zh: : Chika 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Chika? Who's that again?
lines.zh: : Chika？那是谁来着？

lines.en: scene beachday24
: Don’t play dumb with me, asshole. You know exactly who Chika is.
lines.zh: : 别跟我装傻，混蛋。你清楚得很 Chika 是谁。

lines.en: : Sorry. I was just so distracted by your beauty that I momentarily forgot anyone else in the world existed.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我完全被你的美貌晃了神，一时间忘了这世上还有别人的存在。

lines.en: scene beachday25
: You...fucking pervert!
lines.zh: : 你……你这个死变态！

lines.en: : I specifically kept my shirt on so I wouldn’t have to listen to shit like that!
lines.zh: : 我特地没脱上衣，就是不想听到这种狗屁话！

lines.en: : Just tell me where the fuck Chika went! I need to know where she wants me to put her stupid fucking bag!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的直接告诉我 Chika 去哪儿了！我得知道她想让我把她那个破包放哪儿！

lines.en: : Chika? Who’s that?
lines.zh: : Chika？那是谁？

lines.en: scene beachday26
: FUCK IT! I’LL FIND HER MYSELF!
lines.zh: : 去他妈的！老娘自己去找！

lines.en: scene beachday19
And just like that, Yumi vanishes as well...which only leaves {i}one{/i} more girl...
lines.zh: 就这样，Yumi 也消失了……只剩下的最后{i}一个{/i}女孩……

lines.en: I begin to trace lines in the sand with my shoe as I wait for Chinami to come out of the restroom.
lines.zh: 我一边等着 Chinami 从洗手间出来，一边用鞋尖在沙子上画着线。

lines.en: I’m honestly a little surprised the other two let her stay in there by herself.
lines.zh: 说实话我有点意外，另外两个居然放心让她一个人在里面。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like she’s [young]enough to need {i}constant{/i} supervision, but it still seems to me like Chika and Yumi are used to coddling her.
lines.zh: 我是说，她又不是[young]到需要{i}时时刻刻{/i}盯着，但我觉得 Chika 和 Yumi 显然已经习惯把她当宝贝宠着了。

lines.en: Oh well. I’ll just be the nice guy and wait for her to-
lines.zh: 算了。我就当个好人，等着她——

lines.en: : Chinami is here now!
lines.zh: : Chinami 来了！

lines.en: : What? Where?
lines.zh: : 什么？在哪儿？

lines.en: : Behind you!
lines.zh: : 在你后面！

lines.en: scene beachday28
: If Chinami was an assassin, you would be in big, big trouble right now!
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 是刺客的话，你现在就有大——大麻烦了！

lines.en: : I don't know. I think I could take you.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定。我觉得我打得过你。

lines.en: : That's just what Chinami wants you to think.
lines.zh: : 那正是 Chinami 想让你以为的。

lines.en: : Now call her cute and tell her that her swimsuit is the best one here!
lines.zh: : 现在夸她可爱，然后告诉她她的泳衣是这里最好看的！

lines.en: : Chinami is cute.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很可爱。

lines.en: But after seeing the last two swimsuits, I can not, in good faith, declare Chinami the winner of this battle.
lines.zh: 但在看过前两件泳衣之后，我实在没法昧着良心宣布 Chinami 是这场比拼的赢家。

lines.en: scene beachday29
: Yay!~
: Chinami picked this one out for herself! Isn’t her taste super cool?
lines.zh: : 这是 Chinami 自己挑的哦！她的品味是不是超酷？

lines.en: : You are definitely your sister's...sister.
lines.zh: : 你确实是你的姐姐的……妹妹。

lines.en: : That is how sisters work, so yes!
lines.zh: : 姐妹本来就是这样的，所以没错！

lines.en: scene beachday29r
: Big sis Chika says Chinami isn't big enough to wear a bikini yet, but I promise to show you once I am, okay?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐说 Chinami 还不够大，还不能穿比基尼，不过 Chinami 答应你，等够大了一定给你看，好不好？

lines.en: : Sure, but...please don't rush. I think you're fine the way you are.
lines.zh: : 好啊，不过……请别着急。我觉得你现在这样就挺好的。

lines.en: scene noonsky
Just like the other two, Chinami wanders off and starts doing her own thing.
lines.zh: 和另外两个一样，Chinami 也跑开去玩自己的了。

lines.en: I can’t imagine being able to fairly split my time between all three of the girls since the sun is already beginning to set...
lines.zh: 太阳已经开始落山了，我实在没法把时间公平地分给三个女孩……

lines.en: So I think I’m going to have to choose one and just focus on them, unfortunately...
lines.zh: 所以看来我只能挑一个，专心陪她了，遗憾归遗憾……

lines.en: I wonder who that should be though?...
lines.zh: 不过该选谁呢？……

lines.en: menu:
Spend time with Chika
lines.zh: 陪 Chika

lines.en: scene beachday30
I slowly walk up to Chika from behind, trying my best to keep my presence unrecognized.
lines.zh: 我慢慢从背后走向 Chika，尽量不让她察觉到我。

lines.en: Part of me wants to just stare at her until she realizes I’m here but-
lines.zh: 我有点想就这么盯着她看，直到她发现我在这儿，不过——

lines.en: Actually, that’s exactly what I’m going to do.
lines.zh: 其实，我还真就这么干。

lines.en: She looks too good from this angle to not take advantage of the opportunity.
lines.zh: 从这个角度看她实在太好看了，这种机会不能不好好利用。

lines.en: : Enjoying the view?
lines.zh: : 景色不错吧？

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I'm meant to assume that you're talking about the ocean or...something else.
lines.zh: : 我不确定你是不是在说大海……还是别的什么。

lines.en: : We both know you're not paying any attention to the ocean...
lines.zh: : 你我心知肚明，你根本没在看海……

lines.en: scene beachday31
I step to the front of Chika and take a seat on her towel as well.
lines.zh: 我绕到 Chika 面前，也在她的浴巾上坐了下来。

lines.en: : It appears I have been caught red handed.
lines.zh: : 看来我是被当场抓包了。

lines.en: : Am I not cute enough from the front for you?
lines.zh: : 从正面看我不够可爱吗？

lines.en: : Of course you are. I just don't get many opportunities to look at you from that other angle.
lines.zh: : 当然够。只是我很少有机会从另一个角度看你罢了。

lines.en: scene beachday32
: Well forgive me for not creating more opportunities for you to stare at my ass.
lines.zh: : 那原谅我吧，没能多制造点机会让你盯着我的屁股看。

lines.en: : It's fine. Just do your best to create more in the future and everything will turn out okay.
lines.zh: : 没关系。以后尽量多制造点机会，一切就都好办了。

lines.en: scene beachday33
: Aww, how sweet of you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你真贴心。

lines.en: : I feel like you're supposed to be sarcastic right now, but that smile seems genuine so I can’t really tell if you are or not.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你这会儿该是在说反话，可你那笑容又挺真心的，我实在分不清你到底是不是。

lines.en: : I guess I'm being a {i}little{/i} sarcastic...but I also understand that boys will be boys and that if there is an ass, you're probably going to stare at it.
lines.zh: : 我大概是有{i}那么点{/i}反话的意思吧……不过我也明白，男生就是男生，只要有屁股在，你们大概就会盯着看。

lines.en: : Right. And you know {i}all{/i} about boys, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 对。而且你对男生可是{i}了如指掌{/i}啊，是吧？

lines.en: scene beachday31
: Okay, well now you're just being rude.
lines.zh: : 好了，你这可就有点过分了。

lines.en: : I might not be the most experienced when it comes to dating, but it’s not like I don’t {i}understand{/i} boys or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我在谈恋爱这方面也许算不上经验丰富，但我又不是完全不{i}懂{/i}男生什么的。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised at how many articles I’ve read on how to appeal to them and...you know. That sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 你要是知道我读过多少篇讲怎么吸引男生的文章，肯定会大吃一惊……就是那种东西啦。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Trying to capture someone’s heart?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？打算俘获谁的心？

lines.en: scene beachday34
: {i}Maybe~{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许吧~{/i}

lines.en: : But how about you, Sensei? I know we’ve talked about it before...but has anyone been catching your eye lately?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，Sensei？我知道我们之前聊过这个……不过最近有没有谁让你上心？

lines.en: : Well...I chose you today, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我今天选了你，不是吗？

lines.en: scene beachday31
: You did...but my competition was my little sister and a girl who constantly tells you she wants to rip your penis off.
lines.zh: : 你是选了……可我的竞争对手是我亲妹妹，外加一个成天嚷嚷着要把你鸡巴扯下来的女孩。

lines.en: : I don’t know if this is a victory I can take pride in.
lines.zh: : 我都不确定这场胜利值不值得骄傲。

lines.en: : You should. In all honesty, I probably would have picked you before anyone else anyway.
lines.zh: : 应该的。说实话，换作别的情况我大概也会先选你。

lines.en: scene beachday35
: Oh come on...you don't mean that.
lines.zh: : 哦得了吧……你不是真心的。

lines.en: : After seeing you from that...previous angle, I think it would be kind of hard to choose anyone else.
lines.zh: : 在从那个……刚才的角度看过你之后，我想我很难再选别人了。

lines.en: : At least not until I calm down.
lines.zh: : 至少在我冷静下来之前是这样。

lines.en: scene beachday36
Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哦糟糕。

lines.en: : I was hoping for a more romantic answer, you know.
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望听到更浪漫一点的回答呢，你知道的。

lines.en: : You’re lucky I let you stare that long in the first place, Sensei. And even {i}more{/i} lucky that I haven't tossed our little lingerie modeling plan out of the window to punish you.
lines.zh: : 你能盯着看那么久已经是走运了，Sensei。{i}更{/i}走运的是我还没把咱们那个内衣模特的小计划扔出窗外，拿来罚你。

lines.en: : Anything but that. It’s all I have left to look forward to in life.
lines.zh: : 千万别那样。那可是我人生中仅剩的盼头了。

lines.en: scene beachday32
: Aww, really? You poor thing.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真的吗？你真可怜。

lines.en: : I guess you’re just going to have to be a good boy and remain patient, then. And keep hanging out with me, of course.
lines.zh: : 那你大概就只能当个乖男孩，继续耐心等着了。当然，还得继续陪我玩。

lines.en: : Also if you wanted to buy me flowers or...do other romantic things, that would be cool too.
lines.zh: : 另外，如果你想送我花，或者……做点别的浪漫的事，那也挺不错的。

lines.en: : And who knows? If you're lucky, maybe I’ll even give you a little something in return?
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？如果你运气好，说不定我还会给你一点小小的回报？

lines.en: : Does that mean what I think it means?
lines.zh: : 那意思是我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: : I wonder...
lines.zh: : 我猜呢……

lines.en: scene black
Chika and I bask in the sun for another thirty minutes or so before Yumi starts complaining about wanting to go home.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 又晒了大约三十分钟的太阳，之后 Yumi 开始抱怨着想回家。

lines.en: It seems like a bit of a waste to only come to the beach for around an hour, but I guess with the current Chinami situation, that’s really all we can do.
lines.zh: 只来海滩待一个小时左右似乎有点浪费，不过考虑到 Chinami 现在的情况，我们也只能这样了。

lines.en: Besides, it’s not like it was a far drive.
lines.zh: 再说了，路又不远。

lines.en: And I got to spend some time with Chika because of it, so I’m not complaining at all.
lines.zh: 而且我还因此跟 Chika 待了一会儿，所以没什么好抱怨的。

lines.en: In fact, all things considered, today was a pretty good day...
lines.zh: 事实上，总的来看，今天算是相当不错的一天……

$ chika_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump endofweekday
Spend time with Yumi
lines.zh: 陪 Yumi

lines.en: scene beachday37
I manage to find Yumi slouched up against the wall of a nearby restroom after wandering around looking for her for several minutes.
lines.zh: 我转了好几分钟，总算在附近一间洗手间的墙边找到了瘫坐着的 Yumi。

lines.en: The only thing is, she’s fallen asleep...which means that she may very well misunderstand the situation if she wakes up right now.
lines.zh: 问题是，她已经睡着了……也就是说，如果她这会儿醒过来，很可能会误解眼前的状况。

lines.en: scene beachday38
Oh no. How could this have happened?
lines.zh: 哦不。怎么会变成这样？

lines.en: scene beachday39
: Hey. Did you have a nice nap?
lines.zh: : 嘿。午睡睡得香吗？

lines.en: scene beachday40
: W-W-W-W-What the fuck do you want?! And why are you just standing there like a creep?!
lines.zh: : 你、你、你、你他妈的想干什么？！还有你干嘛像个变态一样站在那儿？！

lines.en: : You didn’t try to touch me while I was sleeping did you?! Because I swear to God I’ll fucking murder you!
lines.zh: : 我睡着的时候你没趁机碰我吧？！我向上帝发誓，你要是敢，老子他妈的宰了你！

lines.en: : Calm down...I didn’t touch you. I just wanted to see what you were up to.
lines.zh: : 冷静点……我没碰你。我只是想看看你在干什么。

lines.en: : Bullshit! Like you’d try and talk to {i}me{/i} while Chika’s right over there!
lines.zh: : 放屁！Chika 就在那边，你会跑来找{i}我{/i}说话？！

lines.en: : Nope...came straight for you. I’m actually surprised at how quickly you fell asleep.
lines.zh: : 没有……直接冲你来的。说实话我还挺意外你这么快就睡着了。

lines.en: scene beachday41
: Yeah, well...I don’t fuckin' like the heat.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那又怎样……老娘他妈的就是受不了热。

lines.en: : Then why don’t you take your shirt off?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不把上衣脱了？

lines.en: scene beachday40
: I don't know! Why don't {i}you{/i} fucking kill yourself?!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！{i}你{/i}怎么不他妈的去死一死？！

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Am I really bad enough for you to wish death upon?
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。我真有那么讨人厌，让你盼着我死？

lines.en: : Fuck yes you are!
lines.zh: : 他妈的，没错！

lines.en: I move to sit down next to Yumi and-
lines.zh: 我走过去想坐在 Yumi 旁边，然后——

lines.en: scene beachday42
: Why do you suddenly think you're allowed to sit next to me?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然觉得自己有资格坐我旁边了？！

lines.en: And that happens.
lines.zh: 然后就变成了这样。

lines.en: : It’s a public beach, I can sit wherever I want.
lines.zh: : 这是公共海滩，我想坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

lines.en: : Bullshit! This is the only spot with any shade! I need to be here or I’ll fucking die!
lines.zh: : 放屁！这是唯一有阴凉的地方！我必须待在这儿，不然会他妈的热死！

lines.en: : Then I guess you’ll just have to put up with me.
lines.zh: : 那我看你就只能忍着我了。

lines.en: scene beachday43
: You some kinda masochist or something? Do you get off on girls being mean to you?
lines.zh: : 你是受虐狂还是怎么着？被女生凶让你很爽吗？

lines.en: : Maybe a little bit. Aren’t you the same, though?
lines.zh: : 也许有一点吧。不过你不也一样吗？

lines.en: scene beachday44
: Huh? What? The fuck you talking about?
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？你他妈的在说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know if you’ve realized this, but you tend to blush a lot whenever the two of us are arguing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有没有意识到，每次我们俩吵架的时候，你都特别容易脸红。

lines.en: scene beachday45
: I...I do not!
lines.zh: : 我……我才没有！

lines.en: : You’re doing it right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在就在脸红。

lines.en: : The only reason I’m turning red is because being around you makes my blood boil!
lines.zh: : 我脸红只是因为待在你身边让我血气上涌！

lines.en: : It makes me want to...I don't know! Fucking kill somebody!
lines.zh: : 这让我想……我不知道！他妈的想杀人！

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, really!
lines.zh: : 是真的！

lines.en: : Now, get the hell away from me before I actually do something about it!
lines.zh: : 现在，趁我还没真动手，给我滚远点！

lines.en: : Hmm...
Ignoring her demand, I lean up against the wall Yumi is slouched against, bringing the two of us mere inches apart.
lines.zh: 我没理会她的要求，靠上 Yumi 瘫着的那面墙，把我俩的距离拉近到只有几英寸。

lines.en: At least at first. Yumi instinctively slides away the second my back touches the wall.
lines.zh: 至少一开始是这样。我的背刚碰到墙，Yumi 就本能地往旁边挪开了。

lines.en: : You look cute when you’re about to kill someone, have I ever told you that?
lines.zh: : 你快要杀人的时候还挺可爱的，我跟你说过吗？

lines.en: : What?! No! Who the fuck says something like that?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！没有！谁他妈的会说这种话？！

lines.en: : Do you not like being called cute or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不喜欢被人说可爱还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Not by {i}you{/i} of all fucking people!
lines.zh: : 就是不想被{i}你{/i}这种人渣说！

lines.en: : So it would be fine if someone else called you cute?
lines.zh: : 那换成别人说你可爱就没关系？

lines.en: : No! None of it would be fine! It’s just worse hearing it from someone constantly imagining me with my clothes off!
lines.zh: : 不是！谁说都不行！只是从一个成天想象我脱光衣服的人嘴里听到，更让人火大！

lines.en: : I mean...I don't do it {i}constantly...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……我也没有{i}成天{/i}这样……

lines.en: scene beachday46
: THIS IS EXACTLY WHY I DIDN’T WANT YOU FUCKING COMING HERE TODAY!
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我他妈的打一开始就不想让你来！

lines.en: : I’M JUST GOING TO GO FUCKING DIE IN THE SUN! ANYTHING IS BETTER THAN THIS SHIT!
lines.zh: : 老子宁愿去太阳底下晒死！什么都比这堆狗屎强！

lines.en: : Wait...stay a little longer.
lines.zh: : 等等……再多待一会儿吧。

lines.en: I call out to Yumi as she’s pushing herself off the ground.
lines.zh: 在 Yumi 撑着地准备起身时，我叫住了她。

lines.en: She stops moving, but I’m sure it’s more of a reflex than her actually wanting to stay.
lines.zh: 她停下了动作，但我敢肯定那更多是条件反射，而不是她真想留下。

lines.en: scene beachday47
: What?...And this better be good.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？……你最好说出点像样的东西来。

lines.en: : Can I tell you one thing without you getting mad at me and calling me a pervert or an asshole or something?
lines.zh: : 我能不能说一件事，保证你不会生气，也不会骂我变态或者混蛋什么的？

lines.en: : Probably not, but just fucking say it so I can leave.
lines.zh: : 大概不能，但你他妈的快说，说完我好走人。

lines.en: : Okay, well-
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个——

lines.en: : I really {i}do{/i} think you're cute, Yumi. I'm not just lying to get your shirt off.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}真{/i}心觉得你很可爱，Yumi。我不是为了骗你脱衣服才这么说的。

lines.en: scene beachday46
: FUCK YOU! I’M LEAVING FOR REAL THIS TIME!
lines.zh: : 去你的！这次我是真的走了！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi springs off of the ground and angrily marches over to where Chika is sunbathing.
lines.zh: Yumi 从地上一跃而起，气冲冲地朝 Chika 晒太阳的地方走去。

lines.en: She complains about wanting to go home and, after a bit of prodding, manages to convince her.
lines.zh: 她抱怨着想回家，软磨硬泡了一阵之后，总算把 Chika 说服了。

lines.en: It gets dark several minutes later, so Yumi’s desire to leave wasn’t completely unfounded.
lines.zh: 几分钟后天就黑了，所以 Yumi 想走也不是完全没有道理。

lines.en: But, despite her storming off on me and spending yet another 50%% of her dialogue on insults, I feel like the two of us managed to become slightly closer.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管她甩下我愤然离去，又把对话里另外 50%% 的内容都用在了骂人上，我还是觉得我们俩的关系近了一点点。

lines.en: $ day79 = True
$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump endofweekday
Spend time with Chinami
lines.zh: 陪 Chinami

lines.en: scene beachday49
Not knowing how to choose between Yumi and Chika, I decide to play it neutral by spending time with Chinami.
lines.zh: 在 Yumi 和 Chika 之间不知该选谁，我决定保持中立——去陪 Chinami。

lines.en: Is this the appropriate thing for a man my age to be doing? Absolutely not. But it’s not like I have any ill intentions in doing so.
lines.zh: 一个我这个年纪的男人做这种事合适吗？当然不合适。但我又没有什么恶意。

lines.en: At least...not yet.
lines.zh: 至少……目前还没有。

lines.en: I like to tell myself that I haven't fallen far enough to consider something like that, but...
lines.zh: 我总爱告诉自己，我还没堕落到来考虑那种事的地步，不过……

lines.en: Sometimes, you don't realize how deep you've fallen until you start trying to climb your way back up.
lines.zh: 有时候，你不开始往上爬，就不会意识到自己已经陷得多深。

lines.en: : Hey, Chinami. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chinami。你在玩什么呢？

lines.en: : Playing in the sand!
lines.zh: : 在玩沙子！

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know how to swim, so she likes to just watch the water and look for seashells.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不会游泳，所以 Chinami 喜欢就看着海水，捡捡贝壳。

lines.en: : That’s...nice. Have you found any yet?
lines.zh: : 那……挺好的。捡到了吗？

lines.en: : Nope! I found three hermit crabs, though. Wanna know what I named them?
lines.zh: : 没有！不过 Chinami 找到了三只寄居蟹。想知道 Chinami 给它们取了什么名字吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Hermit Crab 1, Hermit Crab 2, and Hermit Crab 3.
lines.zh: : 寄居蟹 1 号，寄居蟹 2 号，还有寄居蟹 3 号。

lines.en: : Were those really the most interesting names you could come up with?
lines.zh: : 这些真的是你能想出来最有意思的名字吗？

lines.en: scene beachday50
: Are they not good?...
lines.zh: : 不好吗？……

lines.en: : Well, uhh...Actually, they’re fine. They’re...very creative.
lines.zh: : 呃，那个……其实挺好的。它们非常……有创意。

lines.en: I guess I probably shouldn't be pointing out the flaws in a child's minimalist approach to naming sea creatures.
lines.zh: 我想我大概不该去挑一个小孩给海洋生物取名时那种极简主义的毛病。

lines.en: scene beachday51
: Umm...
: Can Chinami ask you a question?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能问你一个问题吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？当然。怎么了？

lines.en: : Why are you spending time with Chinami instead of her big sisters?
lines.zh: : 你为什么陪 Chinami 而不陪她的姐姐们呀？

lines.en: : I don't know. I just...am.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我就是……在陪啊。

lines.en: : Does this mean you like little girls?
lines.zh: : 那是不是说明你喜欢小女孩？

lines.en: I'm not sure what expression crosses my face when Chinami says that, but I'm almost certain it's not a good one.
lines.zh: 我不确定 Chinami 说这话时我脸上是什么表情，但我几乎可以肯定那表情不太好看。

lines.en: I’m sure she doesn’t mean anything by it, but the wrong answer here could...have some pretty hefty repercussions if she tells anyone else about it.
lines.zh: 我相信她没有别的意思，但要是答错了，再让她跟别人一学舌……后果可能会相当严重。

lines.en: As such, I quickly glance over to make sure Chika or Yumi aren’t listening in and getting the wrong idea.
lines.zh: 于是我赶紧瞟了一眼，确认 Chika 或 Yumi 没有在旁边偷听、产生误会。

lines.en: : Chinami...you shouldn’t say things like that.
lines.zh: : Chinami……你不该说这种话。

lines.en: scene beachday52
: How come? Is liking little girls bad?
lines.zh: : 为什么呀？喜欢小女孩是坏事吗？

lines.en: : In this context, probably.
lines.zh: : 在这个语境下，大概是。

lines.en: : In fact, there are very few contexts in which that would not be bad.
lines.zh: : 事实上，能让它不算坏事的语境，少之又少。

lines.en: : What is a {i}context?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}语境{/i}是什么？

lines.en: : Context is like...a particular situation. But yeah, don't ask people that anymore.
lines.zh: : 语境就是……某个具体的情形。不过总之，以后别再问别人这种问题了。

lines.en: scene beachday53
: Hmm...Chinami doesn't really get it. But you’re an adult, so Chinami has to listen to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Chinami 不太懂。不过你是大人，所以 Chinami 得听你的。

lines.en: : Exactly. Good girl, Chinami. Always listen to adults unless they tell you to do something weird.
lines.zh: : 没错。真乖，Chinami。大人说的话要听，除非他们让你做奇怪的事。

lines.en: : Big sis told me about people who try to lure girls like me into big, white vans and sell them on the black market. Is that what you're talking about right now?
lines.zh: : 姐姐跟 Chinami 说过，有人会把像 Chinami 这样的女孩骗进白色的大面包车，然后卖到黑市上去。你说的是这个吗？

lines.en: : Did...Chika really tell you something like that?
lines.zh: : Chika 真的……跟你说了这种话？

lines.en: Chinami shakes her head and continues digging her fingers into the sand.
lines.zh: Chinami 摇了摇头，继续把手指往沙子里挖。

lines.en: scene beachday52
: Big-sis Yumi did. She’s worried that somebody might take me someday, so she’s training me in self-defense and teaching me about all sorts of bad people.
lines.zh: : 是 Yumi 姐姐说的。她担心有一天会有人把 Chinami 拐走，所以她在教 Chinami 防身术，还给 Chinami 讲各种各样的坏人。

lines.en: : Has...she said anything about me?
lines.zh: : 她……有提到过我吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. That’s when she first told me the van thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。她就是那时候第一次跟我说面包车的事的。

lines.en: : She said you might try to steal me away and be really mean to me, but you seem nice!
lines.zh: : 她说你可能会把 Chinami 拐走，还会对 Chinami 很凶，可是你看起来人很好！

lines.en: scene beachday49
: So Chinami has decided it’s okay to get in your van!
lines.zh: : 所以 Chinami 决定了，上你的面包车也没关系！

lines.en: : What's wrong? Did Chinami make a bad decision?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？Chinami 做了个错误的决定吗？

lines.en: : Okay, well...let me preface this by saying to please never get in {i}anyone's{/i} van.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个……我先说在前头，请你永远不要上{i}任何人的{/i}面包车。

lines.en: : Not even yours?
lines.zh: : 连你的也不行吗？

lines.en: : {i}Definitely{/i} not mine.
lines.zh: : {i}尤其{/i}是我的。

lines.en: : I don’t even own a van, Chinami. Nor do I think it would be safe for me to buy one given what you just told me.
lines.zh: : 我连面包车都没有，Chinami。而且听你刚说的这些，我觉得我去买一辆也不太安全。

lines.en: scene beachday53
: Chinami is confused again. If you don’t want a van, you don’t have to get one.
lines.zh: : Chinami 又糊涂了。如果你不想要面包车，不买就是了呀。

lines.en: : That's what the bus is for. And the bus is fun!
lines.zh: : 有公交车不就行了。而且坐公交车很好玩！

lines.en: scene beachday49
: The seats are really big and squishy and Chinami doesn’t need to wear a seatbelt.
lines.zh: : 座位又大又软，而且 Chinami 不用系安全带。

lines.en: : Chinami always needs to wear a seatbelt.
lines.zh: : Chinami 什么时候都得系安全带。

lines.en: : She does?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely. And make sure you tell Chika and Yumi about that so they know I’m not trying to corrupt you.
lines.zh: : 当然。一定要把这话告诉 Chika 和 Yumi，让她们知道我没有在教坏你。

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami wants you and big sis to get married, so she’ll do whatever you tell her to do!
lines.zh: : 好！Chinami 想让你和姐姐结婚，所以你说什么 Chinami 都照做！

lines.en: : Please stop saying things that can be so easily misunderstood...
lines.zh: : 拜托你别再说这种容易被误会的话了……

lines.en: scene black
Chinami and I talk for a little while longer before Chika stops sunbathing and comes to hang out with us.
lines.zh: 我和 Chinami 又聊了一会儿，之后 Chika 不晒了，过来找我们一起玩。

lines.en: Apparently, she felt bad that I had become a self-appointed babysitter all of a sudden...
lines.zh: 看来她有点过意不去，觉得我莫名其妙就自告奋勇当起了临时保姆……

lines.en: And so the three of us built sandcastles until Yumi decided that she had had enough of the beach and wanted to go home for the day.
lines.zh: 于是我们三个一起堆沙堡，直到 Yumi 觉得海滩待够了、想回家为止。

lines.en: All in all, I had a surprisingly good time...even if a good portion of it was spent talking to a girl probably a third of my age...
lines.zh: 总的来说，我玩得出乎意料地开心……尽管有相当一部分时间是花在跟一个大概只有我三分之一年纪的女孩聊天上……
